description:
FILED s529a (Opus agent, 2026-10-31) while fixing #3824.  PRE-EXISTING (the base 77c7d9d7 gives the same).

An ARRAY ELEMENT holding a BLESSED qr// reads back as an unblessed Regexp.

REPRO (scratch/s529a/pr/b4.pl):
    my $o4 = bless qr/x/, 'K';
    my @c4 = ($o4); print ref($c4[0]), "\n";     # perl K, PCL Regexp
    my $t = [$o4];  print ref($t->[0]), "\n";    # perl K, PCL Regexp
    my $c = $o4;    print ref($c), "\n";         # K both
    my %h = (k => $o4); print ref($h{k}), "\n";  # K both

MECHANISM (read, not changed): the element STORE keeps the class (the box is a %p-container-snapshot
since #3824), but the READ, p-aref-unbox-elem, returns the box only for an arrayref / hashref /
coderef / box-in-box / glob ref / dualvar / handle payload -- a regex payload is unboxed to the raw
p-regex-match, whose ref() is Regexp.  The hash twin %p-hash-unbox-elem keeps the box for a blessed
slot and is right.  Likely fix: one arm in p-aref-unbox-elem, `(and (p-box-p elem) (p-box-class elem))`
or the regex payload specifically -- it is a hot read path, so keep the test after the common arms and
measure.
subject: an array ELEMENT holding a BLESSED qr// reads back as Regexp: p-aref-unbox-elem unboxes a regex payload and drops the container class
